tags: Penalizes pubkeys reported via kind 1984. Returns 1.0 for clean pubkeys, approaches 0.0 for severely reported ones. Illegal reports cause immediate zero.
content:
plan
  reports = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [1984], p: [_.targetPubkey], limit: 100}
in
let
  events = reports | [],
  total = length(events),
  ptags = map(events, fn(e ~> find(fetch(e, .tags) | [], fn(t ~> at(t, 0) == 'p' and at(t, 1) == _.targetPubkey)))),
  reasons = map(ptags, fn(t ~> at(t, 2) | 'other')),
  has_illegal = length(filter(reasons, fn(r ~> r == 'illegal'))) > 0,
  has_impersonation = length(filter(reasons, fn(r ~> r == 'impersonation'))) > 0,
  has_spam = length(filter(reasons, fn(r ~> r == 'spam'))) > 0,
  has_profanity = length(filter(reasons, fn(r ~> r == 'profanity'))) > 0,
  has_nudity = length(filter(reasons, fn(r ~> r == 'nudity'))) > 0,
  worst = if has_illegal then 1.0
          else if has_impersonation then 0.8
          else if has_spam then 0.6
          else if has_profanity then 0.3
          else if has_nudity then 0.2
          else 0.1,
  count_factor = if has_illegal then 1
                 else if total > 2 then 1
                 else if total == 2 then 0.67
                 else if total == 1 then 0.33
                 else 0,
  penalty = worst * count_factor
in
  if total == 0 then 1.0
  else 1.0 - penalty
